description: Source code for managing groups within the Mattermost server, including CRUD operations, membership management, synchronization, and WebSocket event publishing.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing group management functionalities.

methods.name: GetGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a group by ID, optionally including member IDs and count based on options.

methods.name: GetGroupByName
methods.description: Retrieves a group by its name.

methods.name: GetGroupByRemoteID
methods.description: Retrieves a group by its remote ID and source.

methods.name: GetGroupsBySource
methods.description: Retrieves all groups from a specific source.

methods.name: GetGroupsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a user ID.

methods.name: CreateGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group after ensuring its name is unique.

methods.name: isUniqueToUsernames
methods.description: Checks if a group name is unique among usernames.

methods.name: CreateGroupWithUserIds
methods.description: Creates a group with specified user IDs, publishes WebSocket event.

methods.name: UpdateGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing group, including member count and WebSocket notification.

methods.name: DeleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes a group and publishes a WebSocket event.

methods.name: RestoreGroup
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted group, updates member count, and notifies via WebSocket.

methods.name: GetGroupMemberCount
methods.description: Returns the member count of a group with restrictions.

methods.name: GetGroupMemberUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users who are members of a group.

methods.name: GetGroupMemberUsersSortedPage
methods.description: Retrieves sorted page of group members with count.

methods.name: GetGroupMemberUsersPage
methods.description: Retrieves page of group members with default sorting.

methods.name: GetUsersNotInGroupPage
methods.description: Retrieves users not in a specific group, paged.

methods.name: UpsertGroupMember
methods.description: Adds or updates a group member, publishes WebSocket event.

methods.name: DeleteGroupMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a group, publishes WebSocket event.

methods.name: UpsertGroupSyncable
methods.description: Creates or updates a group syncable, with validation for channels and teams, publishes WebSocket event.

methods.name: GetGroupSyncable
methods.description: Retrieves a specific group syncable.

methods.name: GetGroupSyncables
methods.description: Retrieves all syncables for a group.

methods.name: UpdateGroupSyncable
methods.description: Updates a syncable, handling deletion logic.

methods.name: DeleteGroupSyncable
methods.description: Deletes a syncable, including associated channels if a team.

methods.name: TeamMembersToAdd
methods.description: Returns users to add to a team based on group syncs since a timestamp.

methods.name: ChannelMembersToAdd
methods.description: Returns users to add to a channel based on group syncs since a timestamp.

methods.name: TeamMembersToRemove
methods.description: Returns users to remove from a team.

methods.name: ChannelMembersToRemove
methods.description: Returns users to remove from a channel.

methods.name: GetGroupsByChannel
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a channel.

methods.name: GetGroupsByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a team.

methods.name: GetGroupsAssociatedToChannelsByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated to channels within a team.

methods.name: GetGroups
methods.description: Retrieves groups with pagination and optional member IDs.

methods.name: TeamMembersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Returns users in a team minus those in specified groups, with pagination.

methods.name: GetGroupsByIDs
methods.description: Retrieves groups by a list of IDs.

methods.name: ChannelMembersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Returns users in a channel minus those in specified groups, with pagination.

methods.name: UserIsInAdminRoleGroup
methods.description: Checks if a user belongs to any admin role group for a syncable.

methods.name: UpsertGroupMembers
methods.description: Bulk add or update group members, with WebSocket notifications.

methods.name: DeleteGroupMembers
methods.description: Bulk delete group members, with WebSocket notifications.

methods.name: publishGroupMemberEvent
methods.description: Publishes WebSocket event for group member changes.
